args: Which merchants drove the December 31 bulk stock correction

The 407 stock_movements kind='adjustment' events (nearly all on 2025-12-31) appeared, in the top-30 detail, to be entirely B2B wholesale merchants (office equipment / industrial supplies) — is that concentration total, or do other merchants/verticals also appear further down the list?
